title: Wildland Firefighting
body:
1,600+ hours of national service with the US Forest Service through AmeriCorps NCCC Forest Corps, reducing wildfire risk across the Western US. Certified Type 2 Firefighter & Type A Sawyer (Bucker and Faller).
Ask me about my favorite prescribed burn I participated in!

title: Film & Media Arts
body: I have a BA in Film & Media Arts alongside my CS degree. I love da movies! (that's why I left the industry/firefighting and came back to study graphics) I have a Regal Unlimited subscription that I love and am trying to see more films in theaters!

title: Other hobbies
body: Ultimate frisbee (10+ years), electric guitar (6+ years), and finding the best pho in every city I go to (forever)
